summary: The Bears beat the Panthers 16-13 on Thursday Night Football in Week 10 at Soldier Field, in a sloppy game decided by Chicago's defense, a solid running game, and timely throws from rookie Tyson Bagent. Carolina scored on a punt return touchdown but never reached the end zone on offense, and Eddy Pineiro's 59-yard fourth-down field goal attempt to tie the game fell short. The note is a live blog with updates, plus viewing information, and it highlights Bryce Young's offensive struggles and the Bears owning Carolina's first-round pick.
one_line: Chicago edged Carolina 16-13 on Thursday Night Football after Eddy Pineiro missed a 59-yard tying field goal in the closing minutes.
key_facts: The Bears beat the Panthers 16-13 on Thursday, Nov. 9, 2023, at Soldier Field in Chicago; kickoff was 8:15 p.m. ET.
By quarter, the Panthers scored 7, 3, 0, 3 and the Bears scored 3, 6, 7, 0.
Ihmir Smith-Marsette returned a punt 79 yards for a touchdown at 8:36 p.m. to give Carolina a 7-0 lead.
D'Onta Foreman's third-quarter touchdown run was the only offensive touchdown of the game and gave Chicago a 16-10 lead.
Frank Reich sent Eddy Pineiro out for a 59-yard attempt on fourth-and-10 in the final minutes, and the kick was short.
Cairo Santos kicked a 54-yard field goal for the Bears after a false start on Cody Whitehair erased a 49-yard attempt.
The Bears improved to 3-7 and the Panthers fell to 1-8; Tyson Bagent improved to 2-2 as a starter.
The Bears own Carolina's first-round pick, making the win a win-win for Chicago.
Outside of a 45-yard completion to Mike Strachan, Bryce Young was 7-of-16 for 24 yards at one point in the second half.
D.J. Moore faced his former team eight months after being traded to the Bears in the deal that sent the No. 1 pick to Carolina.
Panthers edge rusher Brian Burns was out with a concussion.
The Panthers were 3-for-3 on fourth down on their final drive.
Chicago hopes to have Justin Fields back for its Week 11 game in Detroit.
The game aired on Amazon Prime Video with Al Michaels, Kirk Herbstreit and Kaylee Hartung; DAZN carried it in Canada.
